hero.quote: "The only PGA-certified golf course in Vietnam, designed by Greg Norman with magnificent views of the Phan Thiet coastline."

overviewParagraphs: Located within the expansive NovaWorld Phan Thiet resort, the PGA Ocean Course is a crowning achievement in Vietnam's growing golf portfolio. Greg Norman has masterfully utilized the natural contours of the land, creating a layout that is both visually stunning and strategically demanding. The course is defined by its pristine Zoysia grass fairways, rugged bunkering, and sweeping ocean vistas. As a PGA-branded property, it meets the highest international standards, ready to host top-tier professional tournaments while remaining accessible and enjoyable for amateur players. The world-class amenities, including a premier academy and an opulent clubhouse, ensure an unparalleled golf experience from arrival to departure.

curatorBriefHtml: PGA Ocean Course (NovaWorld) is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Phan Thiet, Vietnam, crafted by Greg Norman (2021) and stretching to 7,400 Yards across a coastal parkland environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its pga tour certified design & conditioning (Built to international specs) and panoramic ocean views & undulating dunes (Rugged Australian Sandbelt style).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, PGA Ocean Course (NovaWorld) (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie tour-caliber yardages (Laser-sharp pin management), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phan Thiet golf tour by AGS, PGA Ocean Course (NovaWorld) provides a distinct architectural test by Greg Norman that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.
